topology_reasoning.what_it_is: A 1x4 MMI power splitter: one input access waveguide feeds a solid multimode SLAB (the large black rectangle); the input mode self-images into FOUR output access waveguides leaving the opposite face. Silhouette = big rectangle + 4 tapered prongs on one long edge + 1 tapered prong (input) centered on the opposite edge.
topology_reasoning.how_it_works: Light enters the wide multimode slab through a tapered input; the fundamental input mode excites several slab modes which beat and periodically reconstruct the input field as N-fold self-images at a fixed propagation length (L ~ number of images). Output access waveguides are placed at those self-image positions to tap equal power fractions. Access tapers (single-mode guide width -> wider slab-interface width) reduce insertion loss and reflections at the slab junction.
function_defining_knobs: mmi_length (self-imaging length -> which N-fold image forms; sets split count)
mmi_width (transverse slab width -> image spacing / port pitch envelope)
output_centers_um (transverse self-image positions where the 4 outputs tap)
taper_base_width (access-to-slab taper width -> junction loss/mode match)
output_taper_length / input_taper_length (adiabaticity of the access tapers)

calibration_frame.mapping: compare_absolute + calculate_calibration hard-map footprint_um[0]=25 -> image X (horizontal/transverse, LEFT-ALIGNED) and footprint_um[1]=10 -> image Y (vertical/propagation, CENTERED). Comparison is an anisotropic affine map GDS-bbox -> image-bbox, so the device is built to fill X in [0,25], Y in [0,10] with the drawing's bbox-relative proportions; propagation is the vertical (Y) axis, outputs at Y=10, input at Y=0.
calibration_frame.image_cleaning: The raw device_bw.png carries faint compression noise (gray 243-244, ~7900 px) that reaches the image edges and blew the white_threshold=245 bbox to [123,2,1888,2272] (touching 3 edges). The true silhouette is bimodal and clean at x[319,1690] y[197,1878]. Per the draw-to-gds discipline (a clean device-only silhouette; sub-threshold noise corrupts IoU exactly like a leaked annotation), component.png was binarized at the bimodal midpoint (128) and calibration recomputed on it -> bbox [319,197,1691,1879], scale [54.88, 168.2] px/um. This changed only the calibration frame, never the device silhouette.

measurements_um.note: Measured from the cleaned silhouette; fromtop converted to gds_y = 10 - fromtop.

output_access.pitch_note: non-uniform in the drawing (5.37/6.97/5.73) -- reproduced for fidelity

iterations.change_made: Initial parametric build from precise pixel measurements: rectangle slab (25 x 5.06), 4 output taper+straight prongs at measured self-image centers, 1 centered truncated input taper. All primitives (rectangle, taper, gf.Path+extrude), layer (1,0). bbox exactly (0,0)-(25,10), size_match [true,true].

Correctness fix (no geometry change): write_gds(with_metadata=False) to suppress kfactory's $$$CONTEXT_INFO$$$ cell, which otherwise references the top cell and makes it non-top-level, hiding geometry from spec_optimization._layer_area (top_level() + skip-$$$). Enables the parametric measurement contract; IoU/Dice/SSE unchanged.

stop_reason: IoU 0.9938 >> 0.85 target on iteration 1. diff.png shows only 1-2 px anti-aliased boundary noise along every edge (sharp GDS edges vs anti-aliased target) -- the rasterization ceiling. Remaining ~0.6% is sub-0.25um calibration-frame effects (e.g. full-width slab vs the drawing's ~0.24um side margins under LEFT-ALIGN); chasing it risks regressions. Kept the honest best.

knob_verification.param_meaning: output-1 access straight length; a guide-width (1.57 um) waveguide-length knob. Equal to output_straight_length at base, so all four outputs are identical in the delivered device.
knob_verification.interpretation: Perturbing the knob by 5 um moves lengths.json delta_length_um by exactly 5 um and grows layer-(1,0) area by 1.57*5 um^2 -> the declared knob moves real geometry, not just reported numbers.

measurement_contract.lengths_json: arms = {out1_access_um, out4_access_um} (real output-access centerlines, equal at base), delta_length_um = |L1 - L4|. Written next to the GDS on every run.
